stories.title: Who's better (for now), the SEC or Big Ten? Week 2 could set early CFP narratives
stories.summary: Bluebloods have a chance at the early-season's biggest win. Big 12 and SEC have early conference challenges, and the G6 has an elimination weekend.

stories.title: 'Let's do it for the USA': Shelton looks to end wait in US Open final vs. Zverev
stories.summary: Ben Shelton won an all-American duel with Frances Tiafoe and will play No. 1 seed Alexander Zverev for the US Open title.

stories.title: Jeter reunites with 9/11 victim's daughter as Yanks pay tribute in ceremony
stories.summary: Derek Jeter was among the members of the 2001 Yankees on hand to honor 9/11 victims in a pregame ceremony that concluded with first pitches from Brielle Saracini and Sean McGuire, a married couple whose fathers died on Sept. 11, 2001.

stories.title: BC honors Crowther on 25th anniversary of 9/11 with annual Red Bandanna Game
stories.summary: On the 25th anniversary of 9/11, Boston College hosted Rutgers in its annual Red Bandanna Game on Friday night. It had special meaning for both schools.

stories.title: Europe builds 7-5 lead at Solheim Cup after Korda, Corpuz falter
stories.summary: Team Europe finally took down the record-setting U.S. partnership of Nelly Korda and Allisen Corpuz at the Solheim Cup on the way to winning the morning foursomes and building a 7-5 lead after three sessions.
